venue.name: [Recreation and Physical Activity Center (RPAC)](https://recsports.osu.edu/)
venue.address: 337 Annie and John Glenn Ave. Columbus, OH 43210
venue.details: Tom W. Davis Special Events Gym

information: This competition takes place in the Tom W. Davis Special Events Gym on the bottom floor of the RPAC. Competitors are encouraged to enter through the event entrance on the Northwest side of the RPAC. This competition does not have a limit on guests. However, **all competitiors must be wearing a colored wristband** while attending the competition in order to gain access to the RPAC facility should you choose to leave and return later. You can pick up your wristband at the registration table
